title: Juicy Mediterranean Squid Bowl
description: A light, floral-scented bowl featuring tender squid simmered in lemon and herbs, served over a bed of fresh greens and topped with a zesty lemon-tahini dressing.
instructions: In a small pot, combine cleaned squid, lemon juice, lemon zest, olive oil, and parsley. Simmer gently for 5 minutes until squid is tender but still firm.
While squid simmers, thinly slice red onion and chop spinach.
In a small bowl, whisk together 1 tbsp tahini, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp maple syrup, and 1 tsp minced garlic for the dressing.
Assemble the bowl: place cooked squid on a bed of spinach, top with red onion slices, and drizzle with lemon-tahini dressing.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.
